text: Some garden highlights in the sunshine this morning! 🌱

I have a thief in my garden 🌱!
In the last couple of days I’ve lost lily bulbs, had a Venus fly trap plucked out of its bog planter(!), and this morning found an uprooted iris tuber. 
Suspects? Squirrel for the bulbs, but  no idea who’s snatching flytraps.

Popped over to the #Allotment to do some spring rhubarb jobs, including adding some compost as a mulch.

Here’s a little video I made a couple of years about some tips on rhubarb growing.
